run_handle_translation: run the handle function to translate a batch of text samples via TorchServe
initialize_Handler_model: initialize the Handler to load a Fairseq translation model and SentencePiece tokenizer
preprocess_samples_for_inference: preprocess translation samples into tensors with source tokens and target language prefix
run_Handler_inference: run inference on preprocessed samples using the Fairseq sequence generator
postprocess_translation_output: postprocess inference output into signed JSON responses with translated text
